role: The listener interface the server uses to push container changes to a client: the full window, one slot, or a progress-bar pair.

members.name: sendProgressBarUpdate
members.note: The furnace's S31 bars (gui_furnace_progress); the beacon and enchanting bars are world.conf beacon = off and enchanting = off.

notes: The interface itself is not modeled as a type; the server player's packet queue plays the same role. lane/idxblocks: the furnace progress S31s are sent and compared.
